cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from public_check import run_candidate
# build a large worst-case batch: 2048 jobs, ~4 MiB of processed text, 8192 aliases
rng_dir = {}
for i in range(2048):
    canon = "sip:user%d@dom%d.test" % (i, i % 64)
    rng_dir[canon] = ["sip:a%d_%d@al%d.test" % (i, j, i % 64) for j in range(3)] + \
                     ["tel:+1%04d%06d" % (i % 10000, j) for j in range(3)]
accounts = {("subj%d" % i): {"primary": "sip:user%d@dom%d.test" % (i, i % 64),
                             "allow": ["sip:user%d@dom%d.test" % ((i+k) % 2048, (i+k) % 64) for k in range(1, 40)]}
            for i in range(2048)}
gateways = {("gw%d" % g): {"local_domains": ["dom%d.test" % d for d in range(64)],
                           "peers": {("p%d" % p): ["dom%d.test" % d for d in range(p, p+30)] for p in range(16)}}
            for g in range(64)}
body = "s" * 1500
jobs = []
for k in range(2048):
    who = "sip:user%d@dom%d.test" % (k, k % 64)
    raw = ("INVITE sip:callee@other.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: \"Some, Name\" <%s>;tag=t%d\r\n"
           "To: <sip:callee@other.test>;tag=x2\r\nCall-ID: call-%d\r\nCSeq: %d INVITE\r\n"
           "Via: SIP/2.0/UDP hop.test;branch=z9\r\nContact: <sip:me@hop.test>\r\n"
           "Supported: 100rel,timer\r\nContent-Type: application/sdp\r\n"
           "P-Asserted-Identity: <%s>\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (who, k, k, k % 999999 + 1, who, len(body), body))
    if k % 3 == 2:
        jobs.append({"gateway": "gw%d" % (k % 64), "ingress": {"kind":"peer","name":"p%d" % (k%16)},
                     "trusted_out": True, "source": k-1})
    else:
        jobs.append({"gateway": "gw%d" % (k % 64), "ingress": {"kind":"local","subject":"subj%d" % (k % 2048)},
                     "trusted_out": bool(k % 2), "raw": raw})
batch = {"directory": rng_dir, "accounts": accounts, "gateways": gateways, "jobs": jobs}
data = json.dumps(batch).encode()
print("input bytes", len(data), "sum processed", sum(len(j.get("raw","")) for j in jobs))
t=time.time()
out = run_candidate(__import__('pathlib').Path('/workspace/submission/gateway.py'), data, timeout=60)
print("elapsed %.2fs, stdout %d bytes" % (time.time()-t, len(out)))
res = json.loads(out)["results"]
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(r["status"] if r["status"]=="accept" else r["reason"] for r in res))
print("sample", json.dumps(res[0])[:200])
print("sample peer", json.dumps(res[2])[:200])
PYEOF
